biggest_catch: Official payment timing is up to 21 business days — roughly a month — so this fails the lane's today-or-days payout rule despite the published pay range.
catches: Official FAQ: incentives arrive within 21 business days of study completion — about four calendar weeks.
In-person sessions are 'usually processed at the end of the study session' but still only expected within 21 business days.
Payment is via Virtual Reward (digital gift cards like Amazon or Visa), not cash.
Every study requires screening and a match; availability is profile-dependent.

c1.evidence: Official L&E Opinions FAQ describes the signup → profile → screener → study → paid flow.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Most participants earn $50–$250+ per study, depending on the topic and length.'

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: in-person incentives 'usually processed at the end of the study session. You can expect to have it within 21 business days.' Telephone/online: 'paid out via Virtual Reward in 21 business days after the completion of the study.' 21 business days is weeks, not days.

c4.evidence: Official signup described as free; no participation fee mentioned.

eligibility: 18+, U.S. citizen; matched to studies via profile and screeners
maximize: Not a same-day route — official timing is up to 21 business days. If the timing ever shortens, keep your profile current and answer screeners fast, since invites go to matched profiles first.
notes: A published $50–$250+ range with a 21-business-day payout clock. The range passes but the timing fails the lane rule, so this is an honest reject.
payout_quote: Most participants earn $50–$250+ per study, depending on the topic and length.

s2.note: Timing is officially stated — but at 21 business days it fails the lane's speed rule.

s3.note: Eligibility stated officially: 18+, U.S. citizen, profile-matched.

s4.note: No fee in official signup materials.

s6.note: Amount disclosed per study invitation before participating.

s7.note: Invites continue with an updated profile, but no volume is guaranteed.
